item.title: Reconstructing 16,000 years of summer temperature change in the Western Balkans
item.description: [Climate & Environment] Keyword: climate change — Researchers at Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE) have reconstructed approximately 16,000 years of summer temperature changes from sediments collected at Lake Prokoško in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The findings show how the Western Balkans responded to rapid climate changes at the end of the last glacial period, how warmer and cooler phases unfolded during the Holocene, and how the impact of human land use became increasingly pronounced.

item.title: How life on Earth experiences climate change
item.description: [Climate & Environment] Keyword: climate change — Climate change can look very different at the scale of a forest, field or hillside.
